description: This file defines a CMake script that implements a depth-first search (DFS) traversal over nested map and list data structures, emitting events for each element and reference encountered, and calling a user-provided callback function with event types and data.

methods.name: dfs_callback
methods.description: Main function that initiates the DFS traversal, takes a callback function as argument, and manages the traversal process.

methods.name: dfs_callback_inner
methods.description: Inner recursive function that performs the DFS traversal on a given node, emitting events and handling references.
